items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Edgar Hayes had the band there... Edgar Hayes had the band there and let's see, the drummer was Kaiser Marshall.

ctx.x: Right next door to the Woodside Hotel. It was on 141st I believe and Seventh Avenue. We would go there to cash our recording checks and never get out with a quarter. We would spend the money right in the bar, right there. You know. And Edgar Hayes had the band there. This was a saxophone hangout?
